high_level_description: The image shows two individuals shaking hands in front of a backdrop featuring the European Union flags. The person on the left is a woman with shoulder-length brown hair, wearing a white blouse and black pants. She has a gold bracelet on her right wrist and is smiling warmly. The person on the right is a man with a bald head, wearing glasses, a dark suit, a white shirt, and a red tie with a pattern. He also appears to be smiling. The background consists of two blue flags with yellow stars, which are symbols of the European Union.
